formal_name: Judicial Commission of Inquiry into Criminality, Political Interference, and Corruption in the Criminal Justice System
chairperson: Justice Mbuyiseli Madlanga (Retired Constitutional Court Justice)
origin: Explosive allegations by KZN Police Commissioner Lt-Gen Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi regarding the 'capture' of the justice system by criminal syndicates and political actors.

key_witnesses.name: Lt-Gen Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi
key_witnesses.testimony_summary: Detailed infiltration of SAPS, NPA, and intelligence services by criminal syndicates; alleged sabotage of political killing investigations.

key_witnesses.name: Lt-Gen Dumisani Khumalo
key_witnesses.testimony_summary: Named the 'Big Five' cartel as a sophisticated syndicate involved in drug trafficking, tender fraud, and contract killings.

key_witnesses.name: Major-General Hendrik Flynn
key_witnesses.testimony_summary: Testified regarding the theft of R200 million worth of cocaine from a Hawks storage facility in Port Shepstone (2021).

key_witnesses.name: Witness D (Marius van der Merwe)
key_witnesses.testimony_summary: Key witness assassinated in December 2025 shortly before the submission of the first interim report.

key_witnesses.name: Witness X
key_witnesses.testimony_summary: Detailed corrupt relationship between Vusimuzi 'Cat' Matlala and senior police officials, including Major-General Lesetja Senona.

key_findings: Prima facie evidence of criminality (corruption, fraud, murder, perjury) involving SAPS and EMPD officials.
Systemic infiltration of specific nodes of the justice system by criminal networks.
Immediate referral of matters to the NPA and IPID for prosecution.
Recommendation for immediate suspension of high-ranking officials deemed a threat to investigations.
interim_findings.second_report_focus: Drug seizures and narcotics theft; political interference in senior appointments; in-camera evidence from sensitive witnesses (Witness H).
